description: Deterministic ROI/risk weights and research budgets. Every signal listed here is read from data that already exists in the repository; nothing is estimated or fabricated. A signal that is absent contributes 0 and the remaining weights are renormalized. Unique-added-value weighting favors gaps that add differentiated evidence, safety, mechanism, or claim interpretation over commodity completeness work. Search-index feedback is observation-only evidence that raises enrichment priority for externally rejected pages without changing publication state. The legacy signal weights are uniformly scaled by 0.92, so entities without search-index feedback retain the exact pre-feedback weight ratios after renormalization.

authority_weight.normalization: divide by the maximum observed value in the current corpus

completeness_deficit.source: fraction of contract-enrichable fields that are currently gaps for this entity

maintenance_backlog.source: Maintenance_Queue rows with an open status for this entity_slug

unique_added_value.source: weighted share of differentiated evidence/safety/mechanism fields that are still gaps in Entity_Master
unique_added_value.rationale: Missing differentiated user value should outrank filling low-information metadata gaps merely to make another profile look complete.

search_index_feedback.source: data-sources/search-index-observations.json latest active observation per entity slug
search_index_feedback.rationale: External index-selection rejection is useful evidence that a published page needs more differentiated value or stronger crawl prominence. It changes enrichment priority only and can never directly change publication state.

safety_gap_on_published_entity.rationale: A publicly visible profile missing safety content is a user-harm risk and outranks every traffic opportunity.

claim_integrity_gap_on_published_entity.rationale: A published profile missing a claim-gating field can surface unsupported language.

duplicate_or_integrity_defect.rationale: Duplicate slugs and other structural defects block correct routing.
